        if (abs >= 1000000000000) return "$" + (Number(value) / 1000000000000).toFixed(2) + "T";
        if (abs >= 1000000000) return "$" + (Number(value) / 1000000000).toFixed(2) + "B";
        if (abs >= 1000000) return "$" + (Number(value) / 1000000).toFixed(2) + "M";
        return "$" + Number(value).toLocaleString(undefined, { maximumFractionDigits: 0 });
      }

      function fmtPercent(value) {
        if (value == null || Number.isNaN(Number(value))) return "-";
        return Number(value).toFixed(1) + "%";
      }

      function fmtIndicator(code, value) {
        if (value == null) return "-";
        if (code === "NY.GDP.MKTP.CD" || code === "NY.GDP.PCAP.CD") return fmtMoney(value);
        if (code === "FP.CPI.TOTL.ZG" || code === "SL.UEM.TOTL.ZS" || code === "NE.TRD.GNFS.ZS") return fmtPercent(value);
        return fmtNumber(value);
      }

      function joinValues(values) {
        if (!values) return "-";
        if (Array.isArray(values)) return values.filter(Boolean).join(", ") || "-";
        return Object.values(values).filter(Boolean).join(", ") || "-";
      }

      function countryTimeZones(country) {
        var override = country && COUNTRY_FACT_OVERRIDES[country.cca3] ? COUNTRY_FACT_OVERRIDES[country.cca3] : {};
        var timezones = country && Array.isArray(country.timezones) && country.timezones.length
          ? country.timezones
          : override.timezones;
        return Array.isArray(timezones) && timezones.length
          ? timezones.filter(Boolean).join(", ")
          : "";
      }

      function countryDrivingSide(country) {
        var override = country && COUNTRY_FACT_OVERRIDES[country.cca3] ? COUNTRY_FACT_OVERRIDES[country.cca3] : {};
        var side = country && country.car && country.car.side ? String(country.car.side) : (override.drivingSide || "");
        return side ? side.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + side.slice(1) : "";
      }

      function countryName() {
        return state.country ? state.country.name.common : "";
      }

      function encodedCountry() {
        return encodeURIComponent(countryName());
      }

      function requirementQuery() {
        var raw = $("requirementInput").value.trim();
        return raw || "construction logistics fuel lodging";
      }

      function locationQuery() {
        var city = $("cityInput").value.trim();
        return [city, countryName()].filter(Boolean).join(" ");
      }

      function googleSearch(query) {
        return "https://www.google.com/search?q=" + encodeURIComponent(query);
      }

      function sourceCard(source) {
        var badge = source.badge ? '<span class="badge ' + esc(source.badgeClass || "badge-blue") + '">' + esc(source.badge) + '</span>' : "";
        return [
          '<div class="source-card">',
          '<div>',
          '<div class="source-name">' + esc(source.name) + '</div>',
          '<div class="source-desc">' + esc(source.desc || "") + '</div>',
          '</div>',
          '<div class="source-actions">',
          badge,
          '<a href="' + esc(source.url) + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open</a>',
          '</div>',
          '</div>'
        ].join("");
      }

      function linkRow(label, url) {
        return '<a class="search-link" href="' + esc(url) + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><span>' + esc(label) + '</span><i data-lucide="external-link"></i></a>';
      }

      function kv(label, value) {
        return '<div class="kv"><dt>' + esc(label) + '</dt><dd>' + esc(compact(value)) + '</dd></div>';
      }

      function indicatorCard(code, label, datum) {
        var value = datum ? fmtIndicator(code, datum.value) : "-";
        var year = datum ? "Latest World Bank value: " + datum.date : "No recent API value returned";
        return '<div class="indicator"><div class="indicator-label">' + esc(label) + '</div><div class="indicator-value">' + esc(value) + '</div><div class="indicator-year">' + esc(year) + '</div></div>';
      }

      async function fetchJson(url, timeoutMs) {
        var controller = new AbortController();
        var timer = window.setTimeout(function () { controller.abort(); }, timeoutMs || 9000);
        try {
          var res = await fetch(url, { signal: controller.signal });
          if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Fetch failed: " + res.status);
          return res.json();
        } finally {
          window.clearTimeout(timer);
        }
      }

      async function loadCountries() {
        try {
          var data = await fetchJson("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mledoze/countries/master/countries.json", 16000);
          if (!Array.isArray(data)) throw new Error("Country dataset did not return an array.");
          state.countries = data
            .filter(function (c) { return c && c.name && c.name.common && c.cca3; })
            .sort(function (a, b) { return a.name.common.localeCompare(b.name.common); });
          $("countrySelect").innerHTML = state.countries.map(function (c) {
            return '<option value="' + esc(c.cca3) + '">' + esc(c.name.common) + '</option>';
          }).join("");
          var urlCountry = (new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("country") || "").toUpperCase();
          var preferred = state.countries.find(function (c) { return c.cca3 === urlCountry; }) || state.countries.find(function (c) { return c.cca3 === "QAT"; }) || state.countries[0];
          $("countrySelect").value = preferred.cca3;
          await selectCountry(preferred.cca3);
        } catch (err) {
          $("countrySelect").innerHTML = '<option value="">Country API unavailable</option>';
          showToast("Country list could not load. Check network access.");
        }
      }

      async function selectCountry(iso3) {
        var selected = state.countries.find(function (c) { return c.cca3 === iso3; });
        if (!selected) return;
        state.country = selected;
        state.selectedIso3 = selected.cca3;
        state.selectedIso2 = selected.cca2;
        state.lastRefreshed = new Date();
        markLoading(true);
        renderBase();
        await Promise.allSettled([
          loadExchange(),
          loadWorldBank(),
          loadNews(),
          loadUsaSpendingAwards(true)
        ]);
        renderAll();
        markLoading(false);
      }

      function markLoading(isLoading) {
        ["indicatorGrid", "newsList", "awardList", "contractorList"].forEach(function (id) {
          var el = $(id);
          if (el) el.classList.toggle("loading", isLoading);
        });
      }

      async function loadExchange() {
        state.exchange = null;
        var currencies = state.country && state.country.currencies ? Object.keys(state.country.currencies) : [];
        var code = currencies[0];
        if (!code || code === "USD") return;
        try {
          var data = await fetchJson("https://open.er-api.com/v6/latest/USD", 7000);
          if (data && data.rates && data.rates[code]) {
            state.exchange = { code: code, rate: data.rates[code], date: data.time_last_update_utc || "latest" };
          }
        } catch (err) {
          state.exchange = null;
        }
      }

      async function loadWorldBank() {
        state.indicators = {};
        var iso2 = state.selectedIso2;
        if (!iso2) return;
        var codes = Object.keys(INDICATORS);
        await Promise.all(codes.map(async function (code) {
          try {
            var url = "https://api.worldbank.org/v2/country/" + encodeURIComponent(iso2) + "/indicator/" + encodeURIComponent(code) + "?format=json&per_page=8";
            var data = await fetchJson(url, 7000);
            var rows = Array.isArray(data) ? data[1] : [];
            var latest = rows && rows.find(function (row) { return row && row.value != null; });
            if (latest) state.indicators[code] = { value: latest.value, date: latest.date };
          } catch (err) {
            state.indicators[code] = null;
          }
        }));
      }

      async function loadNews() {
        state.news = [];
        var q = '"' + countryName() + '" (contracting OR procurement OR economy OR security OR logistics OR election OR unrest OR sanctions OR airport OR port)';
        var url = "https://api.gdeltproject.org/api/v2/doc/doc?query=" + encodeURIComponent(q) + "&mode=ArtList&format=json&maxrecords=8&sort=HybridRel&format=json";
        try {
          var data = await fetchJson(url, 7000);
          state.news = (data.articles || []).slice(0, 8);
        } catch (err) {
          state.news = [];
        }
      }

      function fiveYearWindow() {
        var end = new Date();
        var start = new Date(end);
        start.setFullYear(start.getFullYear() - 5);
        function iso(d) { return d.toISOString().slice(0, 10); }
        return { start: iso(start), end: iso(end) };
      }

      function usaSpendingLocationContext() {
        var domestic = US_SPENDING_DOMESTIC_LOCATIONS[state.selectedIso3];
        if (domestic) {
          var domesticLocation = { country: domestic.country };
          if (domestic.state) domesticLocation.state = domestic.state;
          return {
            scope: "domestic",
            locations: [domesticLocation],
            label: domestic.label
          };
        }
        return {
          scope: "foreign",
          locations: [{ country: state.selectedIso3 }],
          label: state.selectedIso3 || "-"
        };
      }

      async function loadUsaSpendingAwards(reset) {
        if (!state.selectedIso3 || state.awardLoading) return;
        if (reset) {
          state.awards = [];
          state.awardPage = 1;
          state.awardHasNext = false;
          state.awardWindow = fiveYearWindow();
        }
        state.awardLoading = true;
        renderAwards();
        var windowRange = state.awardWindow || fiveYearWindow();
        var locationContext = usaSpendingLocationContext();
        var body = {
          filters: {
            award_type_codes: ["A", "B", "C", "D"],
            time_period: [{ start_date: windowRange.start, end_date: windowRange.end }],
            place_of_performance_scope: locationContext.scope,
            place_of_performance_locations: locationContext.locations
          },
          fields: [
            "Award ID",
            "Recipient Name",
            "Recipient UEI",
            "Start Date",
            "End Date",
            "Award Amount",
            "Awarding Agency",
            "Awarding Sub Agency",
            "Funding Agency",
            "Funding Sub Agency",
            "Contract Award Type",
            "NAICS",
            "PSC",
            "Description",
            "Primary Place of Performance"
          ],
          page: state.awardPage,
          limit: 100,
          sort: "Award Amount",
          order: "desc"
        };
        var controller = new AbortController();
        var timer = window.setTimeout(function () { controller.abort(); }, 15000);
        try {
          var res = await fetch("https://api.usaspending.gov/api/v2/search/spending_by_award/", {
            method: "POST",
            headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
            body: JSON.stringify(body),
            signal: controller.signal
          });
          if (!res.ok) throw new Error("USAspending returned " + res.status);
          var data = await res.json();
          var rows = Array.isArray(data.results) ? data.results : [];
          state.awards = state.awards.concat(rows);
          state.awardHasNext = !!(data.page_metadata && data.page_metadata.hasNext);
          state.awardPage += 1;
        } catch (err) {
          if (!state.awards.length) state.awardHasNext = false;
        } finally {
          window.clearTimeout(timer);
          state.awardLoading = false;
          renderAwards();
          renderBrief();
        }
      }

      function renderBase() {
        var c = state.country;
        var currencyCodes = c.currencies ? Object.keys(c.currencies) : [];
        var currencyText = currencyCodes.map(function (code) {
          var item = c.currencies[code];
          return code + (item && item.name ? " - " + item.name : "");
        }).join(", ") || "-";
        var languages = c.languages ? Object.values(c.languages).join(", ") : "-";
        var dialing = c.idd && c.idd.root ? c.idd.root + ((c.idd.suffixes || [])[0] || "") : "-";
        var popDatum = state.indicators["SP.POP.TOTL"];
        var population = c.population || (popDatum && popDatum.value);
        var populationYear = c.population ? "" : (popDatum ? "World Bank " + popDatum.date : "");
        var timeZones = countryTimeZones(c);
        var drivingSide = countryDrivingSide(c);

        $("currencyStatus").textContent = currencyCodes[0] || "-";
        $("currencySub").textContent = currencyText;
        $("populationStatus").textContent = fmtNumber(population);
        $("regionStatus").textContent = [c.region, c.subregion, populationYear].filter(Boolean).join(" / ") || "-";
        $("refreshStatus").textContent = state.lastRefreshed ? state.lastRefreshed.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" }) : "-";
        $("sourceStatus").textContent = "Open country data, World Bank, GDELT, linked sources";
        $("countryName").textContent = c.name.common;
        $("countryAltName").textContent = c.name.official || "";
        $("cca2Badge").textContent = [c.cca2, c.cca3].filter(Boolean).join(" / ");
        $("flagImg").src = c.flags && c.flags.svg ? c.flags.svg : (c.cca2 ? "https://flagcdn.com/" + c.cca2.toLowerCase() + ".svg" : "");
        $("flagImg").alt = c.flags && c.flags.alt ? c.flags.alt : c.name.common + " flag";

        var snapshotRows = [
          kv("Capital", joinValues(c.capital)),
          kv("Languages", languages),
          kv("Dialing code", dialing),
          kv("Top-level domain", joinValues(c.tld))
        ];
        if (timeZones) snapshotRows.splice(2, 0, kv("Time zones", timeZones));
        if (drivingSide) snapshotRows.push(kv("Driving side", drivingSide));
        $("snapshotGrid").innerHTML = snapshotRows.join("");

        $("geoGrid").innerHTML = [
          kv("Region", c.region || "-"),
          kv("Subregion", c.subregion || "-"),
          kv("Continents", c.continents ? joinValues(c.continents) : (c.region || "-")),
          kv("Area", c.area ? fmtNumber(c.area) + " sq km" : "-"),
          kv("Landlocked", c.landlocked ? "Yes" : "No"),
          kv("Coordinates", c.latlng ? c.latlng.join(", ") : "-")
        ].join("");

        $("mapLinks").innerHTML = [
          linkRow("Google Maps", c.maps && c.maps.googleMaps ? c.maps.googleMaps : googleSearch(countryName() + " map")),
          linkRow("OpenStreetMap", "https://www.openstreetmap.org/search?query=" + encodedCountry()),
          linkRow("Airports search", googleSearch(countryName() + " major airports cargo airport")),
          linkRow("Ports search", googleSearch(countryName() + " seaports freight customs"))
        ].join("");

        renderSources();
        renderChecklist();
        loadNotes();
        iconRefresh();
      }

      function renderAll() {
        renderBase();
        renderExchange();
        renderIndicators();
        renderNews();
        renderAwards();
        renderBrief();
      }

      function renderExchange() {
        var c = state.country;
        var currencyCodes = c.currencies ? Object.keys(c.currencies) : [];
        var code = currencyCodes[0] || "";
        $("fxBadge").textContent = code || "FX";
        if (!code) {
          $("exchangeStatus").textContent = "-";
          $("exchangeSub").textContent = "No currency returned";
        } else if (code === "USD") {
          $("exchangeStatus").textContent = "1.00";
          $("exchangeSub").textContent = "Uses USD";
        } else if (state.exchange) {
          $("exchangeStatus").textContent = state.exchange.rate.toLocaleString(undefined, { maximumFractionDigits: 4 });
          $("exchangeSub").textContent = "1 USD to " + state.exchange.code + " on " + state.exchange.date;
        } else {
          $("exchangeStatus").textContent = "Check";
          $("exchangeSub").textContent = "Rate unavailable from open FX feed";
        }

        $("financeGrid").innerHTML = [
          kv("Currency", $("currencySub").textContent),
          kv("USD exchange", $("exchangeStatus").textContent + " " + (code || "")),
          kv("Exchange source", state.exchange ? "Open ER API, " + state.exchange.date : (code === "USD" ? "USD" : "Open FX feed unavailable")),
          kv("Central bank search", countryName() + " central bank"),
          kv("Payment concerns", "Confirm cash/card acceptance, wire reliability, taxes, VAT, and anti-corruption risk."),
          kv("Pricing note", "Capture local inflation, FX volatility, fuel sensitivity, and quote validity periods.")
        ].join("");
      }

      function renderIndicators() {
        $("indicatorGrid").innerHTML = Object.keys(INDICATORS).map(function (code) {
          return indicatorCard(code, INDICATORS[code], state.indicators[code]);
        }).join("");
        $("worldBankBadge").textContent = state.selectedIso2 || "World Bank";
      }

      function renderNews() {
        $("newsBadge").textContent = state.news.length ? "GDELT Live" : "Search Links";
        if (!state.news.length) {
          $("newsList").innerHTML = [
            '<div class="empty-state">Live news could not be pulled from GDELT in this browser session. Use the current-news source links below and capture relevant items in notes.</div>',
            sourceCard({ name: "GDELT country search", desc: "Open-source global news search for country operating picture.", url: "https://api.gdeltproject.org/api/v2/doc/doc?query=" + encodeURIComponent(countryName()) + "&mode=ArtList&format=html&sort=HybridRel", badge: "News", badgeClass: "badge-blue" }),
            sourceCard({ name: "ReliefWeb country updates", desc: "Humanitarian, disaster, health, and security updates.", url: "https://reliefweb.int/countries", badge: "Relief", badgeClass: "badge-green" }),
            sourceCard({ name: "Google News search", desc: "Recent reporting on security, economy, logistics, sanctions, and politics.", url: googleSearch(countryName() + " security economy logistics sanctions procurement news"), badge: "News", badgeClass: "badge-gold" })
          ].join("");
          return;
        }
        $("newsList").innerHTML = state.news.map(function (item) {
          var date = item.seendate ? String(item.seendate).slice(0, 8) : "";
          return [
            '<div class="news-card">',
            '<div class="news-title">' + esc(item.title || "Untitled article") + '</div>',
            '<div class="news-meta">' + esc([item.domain, item.sourcecountry, date].filter(Boolean).join(" / ")) + '</div>',
            '<a href="' + esc(item.url || "#") + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open article</a>',
            '</div>'
          ].join("");
        }).join("");
      }

      function awardLocation(row) {
        var loc = row["Primary Place of Performance"] || {};
        return [loc.city_name, loc.state_name, loc.country_name || countryName()].filter(Boolean).join(", ") || countryName();
      }

      function awardCodeText(value) {
        if (!value) return "-";
        if (typeof value === "string") return value;
        return [value.code, value.description].filter(Boolean).join(" - ") || "-";
      }

      function awardAmount(value) {
        var num = Number(value || 0);
        if (!num) return "$0";
        return fmtMoney(num);
      }

      function awardSearchBlob(row) {
        return [
          row["Award ID"],
          row["Recipient Name"],
          row["Recipient UEI"],
          row["Awarding Agency"],
          row["Awarding Sub Agency"],
          row["Funding Agency"],
          row["Funding Sub Agency"],
          row["Contract Award Type"],
          awardCodeText(row.NAICS),
          awardCodeText(row.PSC),
          row.Description,
          awardLocation(row)
        ].join(" ").toLowerCase();
      }

      function filteredAwards() {
        var term = (($("awardSearchInput") && $("awardSearchInput").value) || "").trim().toLowerCase();
        if (!term) return state.awards;
        return state.awards.filter(function (row) {
          return awardSearchBlob(row).indexOf(term) !== -1;
        });
      }

      function contractorSummary(rows) {
        var map = {};
        rows.forEach(function (row) {
          var name = row["Recipient Name"] || "Unknown recipient";
          if (!map[name]) {
            map[name] = { name: name, uei: row["Recipient UEI"] || "", amount: 0, count: 0, agencies: {}, naics: {}, psc: {} };
          }
          map[name].amount += Number(row["Award Amount"] || 0);
          map[name].count += 1;
          if (row["Awarding Agency"]) map[name].agencies[row["Awarding Agency"]] = true;
          var naics = awardCodeText(row.NAICS);
          var psc = awardCodeText(row.PSC);
          if (naics !== "-") map[name].naics[naics] = true;
          if (psc !== "-") map[name].psc[psc] = true;
          if (row["Recipient UEI"] && !map[name].uei) map[name].uei = row["Recipient UEI"];
        });
        return Object.values(map).sort(function (a, b) { return b.amount - a.amount; });
      }

      function renderAwards() {
        if (!$("awardSummary") || !$("awardList")) return;
        var rows = filteredAwards();
        var contractors = contractorSummary(rows);
        var loadedContractors = contractorSummary(state.awards);
        var totalAmount = rows.reduce(function (sum, row) { return sum + Number(row["Award Amount"] || 0); }, 0);
        var windowRange = state.awardWindow || fiveYearWindow();
        var locationContext = usaSpendingLocationContext();
        $("awardWindowBadge").textContent = windowRange.start + " to " + windowRange.end;
        $("awardBadge").textContent = state.awardLoading ? "Loading" : locationContext.label;
        $("loadMoreAwardsBtn").disabled = state.awardLoading || !state.awardHasNext;
        $("loadMoreAwardsBtn").innerHTML = state.awardLoading ? '<i data-lucide="loader"></i>Loading' : '<i data-lucide="plus"></i>Load 100 more';
        $("awardLoadStatus").textContent = state.awardLoading
          ? "Pulling USAspending award records for " + locationContext.label + "..."
          : (state.awardHasNext ? "Loaded " + state.awards.length + " award records for " + locationContext.label + ". More records are available." : "Loaded " + state.awards.length + " award records for " + locationContext.label + ". No additional page reported.");

        $("awardSummary").innerHTML = [
          '<div class="award-stat"><div class="award-stat-label">Loaded Awards</div><div class="award-stat-value">' + esc(fmtNumber(state.awards.length)) + '</div></div>',
          '<div class="award-stat"><div class="award-stat-label">Visible Awards</div><div class="award-stat-value">' + esc(fmtNumber(rows.length)) + '</div></div>',
          '<div class="award-stat"><div class="award-stat-label">Unique Contractors</div><div class="award-stat-value">' + esc(fmtNumber(loadedContractors.length)) + '</div></div>',
          '<div class="award-stat"><div class="award-stat-label">Visible Obligations</div><div class="award-stat-value">' + esc(awardAmount(totalAmount)) + '</div></div>'
        ].join("");

        if (state.awardLoading && !state.awards.length) {
          $("contractorList").innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state">Pulling the first 100 contract award records from USAspending for ' + esc(countryName()) + ' using ' + esc(locationContext.label) + '.</div>';
          $("awardList").innerHTML = "";
          iconRefresh();
          return;
        }
        if (!state.awards.length) {
          $("contractorList").innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state">No USAspending contract awards loaded for ' + esc(countryName()) + ' using ' + esc(locationContext.label) + '. Try the USAspending search link, or refresh the dossier if the public API timed out.</div>';
          $("awardList").innerHTML = "";
          iconRefresh();
          return;
        }

        $("contractorList").innerHTML = contractors.slice(0, 25).map(function (item) {
          var agencies = Object.keys(item.agencies).slice(0, 3).join(" / ") || "-";
          var naics = Object.keys(item.naics).slice(0, 3).join(" | ") || "-";
          return [
            '<div class="contractor-card">',
            '<div>',
            '<div class="contractor-name">' + esc(item.name) + '</div>',
            '<div class="contractor-meta"><strong>UEI:</strong> ' + esc(item.uei || "-") + '   <strong>Awards:</strong> ' + esc(item.count) + '   <strong>Loaded amount:</strong> ' + esc(awardAmount(item.amount)) + '</div>',
            '<div class="contractor-meta"><strong>Agencies:</strong> ' + esc(agencies) + '</div>',
            '<div class="contractor-meta"><strong>NAICS:</strong> ' + esc(naics) + '</div>',
            '</div>',
            '<div class="source-actions"><span class="badge badge-blue">Vendor</span></div>',
            '</div>'
          ].join("");
        }).join("");

        if (!rows.length) {
          $("awardList").innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state">No loaded awards match the current filter. Clear the filter or load more records.</div>';
          iconRefresh();
          return;
        }

        $("awardList").innerHTML = rows.map(function (row) {
          var naics = awardCodeText(row.NAICS);
          var psc = awardCodeText(row.PSC);
          var awardUrl = row.generated_internal_id ? "https://www.usaspending.gov/award/" + encodeURIComponent(row.generated_internal_id) : "https://www.usaspending.gov/search";
          return [
            '<div class="award-card">',
            '<div class="award-title">' + esc(row["Recipient Name"] || "Unknown recipient") + '</div>',
            '<div class="award-meta"><strong>Award:</strong> <a href="' + esc(awardUrl) + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener" style="color: var(--accent); font-weight: 800; text-decoration: none;">' + esc(row["Award ID"] || "-") + '</a>   <strong>UEI:</strong> ' + esc(row["Recipient UEI"] || "-") + '   <strong>Amount:</strong> ' + esc(awardAmount(row["Award Amount"])) + '</div>',
            '<div class="award-meta"><strong>Period:</strong> ' + esc([row["Start Date"], row["End Date"]].filter(Boolean).join(" to ") || "-") + '   <strong>Place:</strong> ' + esc(awardLocation(row)) + '</div>',
            '<div class="award-meta"><strong>Awarding:</strong> ' + esc([row["Awarding Agency"], row["Awarding Sub Agency"]].filter(Boolean).join(" / ") || "-") + '</div>',
            '<div class="award-desc">' + esc(row.Description || "No description provided.") + '</div>',
            '<div class="award-tags">',
            '<span class="badge badge-blue">' + esc(row["Contract Award Type"] || "Contract") + '</span>',
            '<span class="badge badge-green">NAICS ' + esc(naics) + '</span>',
            '<span class="badge badge-gold">PSC ' + esc(psc) + '</span>',
            '</div>',
            '</div>'
          ].join("");
        }).join("");
        iconRefresh();
      }

      function csvEscape(value) {
        var text = String(value == null ? "" : value);
        return '"' + text.replace(/"/g, '""') + '"';
      }

      function exportAwardsCsv() {
        var rows = filteredAwards();
        if (!rows.length) {
          showToast("No loaded awards to export.");
          return;
        }
        var headers = ["Recipient Name", "Recipient UEI", "Award ID", "Award Amount", "Start Date", "End Date", "Awarding Agency", "Awarding Sub Agency", "Funding Agency", "Funding Sub Agency", "NAICS", "PSC", "Place of Performance", "Description"];
        var csvRows = [headers.map(csvEscape).join(",")].concat(rows.map(function (row) {
          return [
            row["Recipient Name"],
            row["Recipient UEI"],
            row["Award ID"],
            row["Award Amount"],
            row["Start Date"],
            row["End Date"],
            row["Awarding Agency"],
            row["Awarding Sub Agency"],
            row["Funding Agency"],
            row["Funding Sub Agency"],
            awardCodeText(row.NAICS),
            awardCodeText(row.PSC),
            awardLocation(row),
            row.Description
          ].map(csvEscape).join(",");
        }));
        var blob = new Blob([csvRows.join("\n")], { type: "text/csv;charset=utf-8" });
        var link = document.createElement("a");
        link.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        link.download = (state.selectedIso3 || "country") + "-usg-awards-" + fiveYearWindow().end + ".csv";
        document.body.appendChild(link);
        link.click();
        document.body.removeChild(link);
        window.setTimeout(function () { URL.revokeObjectURL(link.href); }, 500);
        showToast("CSV exported.");
      }

      async function copyContractors() {
        var contractors = contractorSummary(filteredAwards());
        if (!contractors.length) {
          showToast("No loaded contractors to copy.");
          return;
        }
        var text = contractors.map(function (item) {
          return item.name + " | UEI: " + (item.uei || "-") + " | Awards loaded: " + item.count + " | Amount loaded: " + awardAmount(item.amount);
        }).join("\n");
        try {
          await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
        } catch (err) {
          var temp = document.createElement("textarea");
          temp.value = text;
          document.body.appendChild(temp);
          temp.select();
          document.execCommand("copy");
          document.body.removeChild(temp);
        }
        showToast("Loaded contractor list copied.");
      }

      function renderSources() {
        var name = countryName();
        var q = requirementQuery();
        var loc = locationQuery();
        var marketQuery = name + " Country Commercial Guide market procurement business customs";
        var travelQuery = name + " site:travel.state.gov International Travel Country Information";
        var embassyQuery = "U.S. Embassy " + name;

        $("clearanceSources").innerHTML = [
          sourceCard({ name: "APACS / Foreign Clearance Guide", desc: "Authorized country clearance and FCG access point. Do not copy restricted content into this tool.", url: "https://apacs.milcloud.mil/fcg/index.html", badge: "Official", badgeClass: "badge-gold" }),
          sourceCard({ name: "State Department travel advisory", desc: "Country risk level, entry/exit, local laws, and safety notes.", url: "https://travel.state.gov/content/travel/en/international-travel/travel-advisories.html", badge: "State", badgeClass: "badge-blue" }),
          sourceCard({ name: "Country information page search", desc: "Direct search for passport validity, visa, customs, and local law information.", url: googleSearch(travelQuery), badge: "Entry", badgeClass: "badge-blue" }),
          sourceCard({ name: "U.S. Embassy search", desc: "Embassy/consulate contacts, security messages, and local services.", url: googleSearch(embassyQuery), badge: "Embassy", badgeClass: "badge-green" })
        ].join("");

        $("healthSources").innerHTML = [

          sourceCard({ name: "UN Comtrade", desc: "Imports, exports, trade partners, and commodity movement data.", url: "https://comtradeplus.un.org/", badge: "Trade", badgeClass: "badge-gold" })

        $("vendorSources").innerHTML = [

          sourceCard({ name: "Company registry search", desc: "Find the official company registry or business registration portal.", url: googleSearch(name + " official company registry business registration"), badge: "Registry", badgeClass: "badge-green" }),

          sourceCard({ name: "Chamber of commerce search", desc: "Local chambers, U.S. business councils, and industry associations.", url: googleSearch(name + " chamber of commerce " + q), badge: "Chamber", badgeClass: "badge-blue" }),
          sourceCard({ name: "SAM.gov opportunity search", desc: "Federal opportunities and award context tied to the country or requirement.", url: "https://sam.gov/search/?index=opp&keywords=" + encodeURIComponent(name + " " + q), badge: "SAM", badgeClass: "badge-green" })
        ].join("");

        $("vettingSources").innerHTML = [
          sourceCard({ name: "OFAC sanctions search", desc: "Screen vendor names, owners, banks, and counterparties.", url: "https://sanctionssearch.ofac.treas.gov/", badge: "Sanctions", badgeClass: "badge-red" }),
          sourceCard({ name: "SAM.gov exclusions", desc: "Check exclusions and responsibility-related restrictions.", url: "https://sam.gov/search/?index=ei", badge: "Exclusions", badgeClass: "badge-red" }),
          sourceCard({ name: "World Bank debarred firms", desc: "Screen debarred and cross-debarred firms and individuals.", url: "https://www.worldbank.org/en/projects-operations/procurement/debarred-firms", badge: "Debarment", badgeClass: "badge-red" }),
          sourceCard({ name: "UN Security Council sanctions", desc: "Screen applicable UN sanctions lists.", url: "https://main.un.org/securitycouncil/en/content/un-sc-consolidated-list", badge: "UN", badgeClass: "badge-red" }),
          sourceCard({ name: "Adverse media search", desc: "Search for corruption, fraud, litigation, sanctions, or reputational red flags.", url: googleSearch('"' + q + '" "' + name + '" vendor corruption fraud sanctions litigation'), badge: "Media", badgeClass: "badge-gold" })
        ].join("");

        $("financeSources").innerHTML = [
          sourceCard({ name: "Central bank search", desc: "Currency, banking rules, foreign exchange guidance, and payment environment.", url: googleSearch(name + " central bank foreign exchange rules"), badge: "Bank", badgeClass: "badge-blue" }),
          sourceCard({ name: "Tax / VAT search", desc: "Local VAT, withholding tax, invoicing, and import tax considerations.", url: googleSearch(name + " VAT tax withholding invoice foreign contractor"), badge: "Tax", badgeClass: "badge-gold" }),
          sourceCard({ name: "IMF country page search", desc: "Macro conditions, Article IV reports, inflation, and fiscal context.", url: googleSearch("IMF " + name + " country report inflation exchange rate"), badge: "IMF", badgeClass: "badge-green" })
        ].join("");

        $("complianceSources").innerHTML = [
          sourceCard({ name: "Transparency International CPI", desc: "Corruption perception signal for source selection and vendor risk context.", url: "https://www.transparency.org/en/cpi", badge: "CPI", badgeClass: "badge-gold" }),
          sourceCard({ name: "Export control / restricted item search", desc: "Screen import/export controls, sanctions, and restricted commodities.", url: googleSearch(name + " import restrictions export controls restricted goods"), badge: "Controls", badgeClass: "badge-red" }),
          sourceCard({ name: "Labor and employment law search", desc: "Host-nation labor, wage, work permit, and subcontracting considerations.", url: googleSearch(name + " labor law work permit contractor employment"), badge: "Labor", badgeClass: "badge-blue" })

          kv("Road movement", (drivingSide ? "Driving side: " + drivingSide + ". " : "") + "Review road safety, seasonal constraints, border crossings, and convoy limitations."),
          kv("Telecom", "Identify mobile operators, SIM/eSIM rules, and internet reliability."),
          kv("Power", "Confirm voltage, plug type, generator/fuel availability, and outages."),
          kv("Lodging", "Screen lodging market, security posture, payment methods, and tax treatment.")
        ];
        if (timeZones) logisticsRows.unshift(kv("Time zones", timeZones));
        $("logisticsGrid").innerHTML = logisticsRows.join("");

        $("logisticsSources").innerHTML = [
          sourceCard({ name: "Airport and cargo search", desc: "Major airports, cargo handlers, and ground transport.", url: googleSearch(name + " major airports cargo handler freight forwarder"), badge: "Air", badgeClass: "badge-blue" }),
          sourceCard({ name: "Port and customs broker search", desc: "Seaports, customs brokers, freight forwarders, and import requirements.", url: googleSearch(name + " seaport customs broker freight forwarder import requirements"), badge: "Port", badgeClass: "badge-green" }),
          sourceCard({ name: "Telecom provider search", desc: "Mobile carriers, internet providers, SIM rules, and coverage.", url: googleSearch(name + " mobile operators internet providers SIM card business"), badge: "Comms", badgeClass: "badge-blue" }),
          sourceCard({ name: "Weather and disaster search", desc: "Seasonal constraints, flooding, heat, storms, or other operating hazards.", url: googleSearch(name + " seasonal weather disaster risk logistics"), badge: "Weather", badgeClass: "badge-gold" })

      function renderChecklist() {
        var key = checklistKey();
        var saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(key) || "[]");
        $("checklist").innerHTML = CHECK_ITEMS.map(function (item, idx) {
          var checked = saved.indexOf(idx) !== -1 ? " checked" : "";
          return '<label class="check-row"><input type="checkbox" data-check="' + idx + '"' + checked + '><span>' + esc(item) + '</span></label>';
        }).join("");
        $("checklist").querySelectorAll("input").forEach(function (box) {
          box.addEventListener("change", saveChecklist);
        });
        updateScore();
      }

      function checklistKey() {
        return "kthq-country-dossier-checks-" + (state.selectedIso3 || "none");
      }

      function notesKey() {
        return "kthq-country-dossier-notes-" + (state.selectedIso3 || "none");
      }

      function saveChecklist() {
        var values = Array.from($("checklist").querySelectorAll("input:checked")).map(function (box) {
          return Number(box.getAttribute("data-check"));
        });
        localStorage.setItem(checklistKey(), JSON.stringify(values));
        updateScore();
      }

      function updateScore() {
        var checked = $("checklist").querySelectorAll("input:checked").length;
        var total = CHECK_ITEMS.length;
        var pct = total ? Math.round((checked / total) * 100) : 0;
        $("readinessBadge").textContent = pct + "%";
        $("scoreText").textContent = pct + "%";
        $("scoreRing").style.setProperty("--score", (pct * 3.6) + "deg");
      }

      function loadNotes() {
        $("notesInput").value = localStorage.getItem(notesKey()) || "";
      }

      function saveNotes() {
        localStorage.setItem(notesKey(), $("notesInput").value);
        showToast("Notes saved for " + countryName() + ".");
        renderBrief();
      }

      function clearNotes() {
        $("notesInput").value = "";
        localStorage.removeItem(notesKey());
        showToast("Notes cleared.");
        renderBrief();
      }

      function renderBrief() {
        var c = state.country;
        if (!c) return;
        var currency = c.currencies ? Object.keys(c.currencies).join(", ") : "-";
        var popDatum = state.indicators["SP.POP.TOTL"];
        var population = fmtNumber(c.population || (popDatum && popDatum.value));
        var timezones = countryTimeZones(c);
        var drivingSide = countryDrivingSide(c);
        var gdp = state.indicators["NY.GDP.MKTP.CD"];
        var inflation = state.indicators["FP.CPI.TOTL.ZG"];
        var note = $("notesInput").value.trim();
        var topNews = state.news.slice(0, 3).map(function (item) { return item.title; }).filter(Boolean);
        var topContractors = contractorSummary(state.awards).slice(0, 8).map(function (item) {
          return item.name + " (" + item.count + " awards loaded, " + awardAmount(item.amount) + ")";
        });
        var countryFacts = [
          "Capital: " + joinValues(c.capital),
          "Population: " + population,
          "Languages: " + joinValues(c.languages)
        ];
        if (timezones) countryFacts.push("Time zones: " + timezones);
        if (drivingSide) countryFacts.push("Driving side: " + drivingSide);
        var financeFacts = [
          "Currency: " + currency,
          "USD exchange: " + $("exchangeStatus").textContent
        ];
        if (gdp) financeFacts.push("GDP: " + fmtMoney(gdp.value) + " (" + gdp.date + ")");
        if (inflation) financeFacts.push("Inflation: " + fmtPercent(inflation.value) + " (" + inflation.date + ")");
        var rows = [
          { title: "BLUF", desc: c.name.common + " dossier refreshed " + (state.lastRefreshed ? state.lastRefreshed.toLocaleString() : "today") + ". Validate clearance, legal, vendor, and payment decisions against official systems before use." },
          { title: "Country facts", desc: countryFacts.join(". ") + "." },
          { title: "Finance", desc: financeFacts.join(". ") + "." },
          { title: "Market research", desc: "Review ITA Country Commercial Guide, World Bank indicators, UN Comtrade, local chamber/registry sources, and host-nation tender portals for requirement: " + requirementQuery() + "." },
          { title: "USG contractors", desc: topContractors.length ? topContractors.join(" | ") : "No USAspending award records loaded yet." },
          { title: "Vendor vetting", desc: "Screen vendor leads through OFAC, SAM.gov exclusions, World Bank debarment, UN sanctions, company registry data, and adverse media before relying on quotes." },
          { title: "Current operating picture", desc: topNews.length ? topNews.join(" | ") : "No live news pulled. Use GDELT, ReliefWeb, State, and local media searches." },
          { title: "Local notes", desc: note || "No local notes saved." }
        ];
        $("briefOutput").innerHTML = rows.map(function (row) {
          return '<div class="brief-row"><div class="brief-title">' + esc(row.title) + '</div><div class="brief-desc">' + esc(row.desc) + '</div></div>';
        }).join("");
      }

      function briefText() {
        var c = state.country;
        if (!c) return "";
        var popDatum = state.indicators["SP.POP.TOTL"];
        var population = fmtNumber(c.population || (popDatum && popDatum.value));
        var timezones = countryTimeZones(c);
        var drivingSide = countryDrivingSide(c);
        var lines = [];
        lines.push("KTHQ Country Contracting Dossier - " + c.name.common);
        lines.push("Refreshed: " + (state.lastRefreshed ? state.lastRefreshed.toLocaleString() : ""));
        lines.push("");
        lines.push("COUNTRY SNAPSHOT");
        lines.push("Official name: " + (c.name.official || c.name.common));
        lines.push("Capital: " + joinValues(c.capital));
        lines.push("Population: " + population);
        lines.push("Region: " + [c.region, c.subregion].filter(Boolean).join(" / "));
        lines.push("Languages: " + joinValues(c.languages));
        if (timezones) lines.push("Time zones: " + timezones);
        if (drivingSide) lines.push("Driving side: " + drivingSide);
        lines.push("Currency: " + $("currencySub").textContent);
        lines.push("USD exchange: " + $("exchangeSub").textContent);
        lines.push("");
        lines.push("MARKET / VENDOR RESEARCH");
        lines.push("Requirement keyword: " + requirementQuery());
        lines.push("Operating area: " + (locationQuery() || c.name.common));
        lines.push("Use ITA Country Commercial Guide, World Bank, UN Comtrade, local registry, chamber, tender portals, and adverse media searches.");
        lines.push("");
        lines.push("USG CONTRACTORS LOADED FROM USASPENDING");
        var contractors = contractorSummary(state.awards).slice(0, 25);
        if (contractors.length) {
          contractors.forEach(function (item) {
            lines.push("- " + item.name + " | UEI: " + (item.uei || "-") + " | awards loaded: " + item.count + " | amount loaded: " + awardAmount(item.amount));
          });
        } else {
          lines.push("- No USAspending award records loaded yet.");
        }
        lines.push("");
        lines.push("VETTING");
        lines.push("Screen vendors through OFAC, SAM.gov exclusions, World Bank debarment, UN sanctions, registry status, ownership, banking legitimacy, and adverse media.");
        lines.push("");
        lines.push("CURRENT NEWS");
        if (state.news.length) {
          state.news.slice(0, 5).forEach(function (item) {
            lines.push("- " + (item.title || "Untitled") + " (" + (item.domain || "source") + ") " + (item.url || ""));
          });
        } else {
          lines.push("- Live news unavailable. Check GDELT, ReliefWeb, State, and local media.");
        }
        lines.push("");
        lines.push("NOTES");
        lines.push($("notesInput").value.trim() || "No notes saved.");
        return lines.join("\n");
      }

      async function copyBrief() {
        var text = briefText();
        if (!text) return;
        try {
          await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
          showToast("Brief copied to clipboard.");
        } catch (err) {
          var temp = document.createElement("textarea");
          temp.value = text;
          document.body.appendChild(temp);
          temp.select();
          document.execCommand("copy");
          document.body.removeChild(temp);
          showToast("Brief copied to clipboard.");
        }
      }

      function showToast(message) {
        var toast = $("toast");
        toast.textContent = message;
        toast.classList.add("show");
        window.clearTimeout(showToast.timer);
        showToast.timer = window.setTimeout(function () {
          toast.classList.remove("show");
        }, 2200);
      }

      function bindEvents() {
        $("countrySelect").addEventListener("change", function (event) {
          selectCountry(event.target.value);
        });
        $("refreshBtn").addEventListener("click", function () {
          selectCountry($("countrySelect").value);
        });
        $("requirementInput").addEventListener("input", function () {
          renderSources();
          renderBrief();
        });
        $("cityInput").addEventListener("input", function () {
          renderSources();
        });
        $("copyBriefBtn").addEventListener("click", copyBrief);
        $("printBtn").addEventListener("click", function () { window.print(); });
        $("loadMoreAwardsBtn").addEventListener("click", function () { loadUsaSpendingAwards(false); });
        $("awardSearchInput").addEventListener("input", renderAwards);
        $("copyContractorsBtn").addEventListener("click", copyContractors);
        $("exportAwardsBtn").addEventListener("click", exportAwardsCsv);
        $("saveNotesBtn").addEventListener("click", saveNotes);
        $("clearNotesBtn").addEventListener("click", clearNotes);
        $("notesInput").addEventListener("input", function () {
          window.clearTimeout(bindEvents.noteTimer);
          bindEvents.noteTimer = window.setTimeout(saveNotes, 900);
        });
        document.querySelectorAll(".tab-btn").forEach(function (btn) {
          btn.addEventListener("click", function () {
            var tab = btn.getAttribute("data-tab");
            document.querySelectorAll(".tab-btn").forEach(function (b) { b.classList.toggle("active", b === btn); });
            document.querySelectorAll(".tab-panel").forEach(function (panel) {
              panel.classList.toggle("active", panel.id === "panel-" + tab);
            });
          });
        });
      }

      bindEvents();
      iconRefresh();
      loadCountries();
    })();
  </script>

axe.renderedHtml:
<!DOCTYPE html><html lang="en" style="--cfm-accent: #7c3aed;"><head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>Provision & Clause Matrix - ContractingHQ</title>
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="styles.css">
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600;700;800&family=Rajdhani:wght@500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">

  <style>
    :root {
      --accent: #4a9eff;
      --bg-dark: #040d1f;
      --bg-card: rgba(10,22,50,0.8);
      --border-color: rgba(74,158,255,0.12);
      --text-primary: #e2e8f0;
      --text-muted: #94a3b8;
      --spacing: 1rem;
    }

    * {
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      box-sizing: border-box;
    }

    html, body {
      font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
      background: var(--bg-dark);
      color: var(--text-primary);
      line-height: 1.6;
    }

    body {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      min-height: 100vh;
    }

    main {
      flex: 1;
    }

    /* Hero Section */
    .hero {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(74,158,255,0.08) 0%, rgba(10,22,50,0.8) 100%);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
      padding: 3rem var(--spacing);
      text-align: center;
    }

    .hero-inner {
      max-width: 900px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    .hero-tag {
      display: inline-block;
      background: rgba(74,158,255,0.15);
      color: var(--accent);
      padding: 0.35rem 0.75rem;
      border-radius: 20px;
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
    }

    .hero h1 {
      font-family: 'Rajdhani', sans-serif;
      font-size: 2.5rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #4a9eff, #94a3b8);
      -webkit-background-clip: text;
      -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
      background-clip: text;
    }

    .hero p {
      color: var(--text-muted);
      max-width: 700px;
      margin: 0 auto 1rem;
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      line-height: 1.7;
    }

    .hero-summary {
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      color: var(--accent);
      font-weight: 600;
      margin-top: 1rem;
    }

    /* Container */
    .container {
      max-width: 1400px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: var(--spacing);
      width: 100%;
    }

    /* Filter Panel Card */
    .filter-card {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
      border-radius: 14px;
      padding: 1.5rem;
      margin-bottom: 2rem;
    }

    .filter-header {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
    }

    .filter-header h3 {
      font-family: 'Rajdhani', sans-serif;
      font-size: 1.1rem;
      font-weight: 600;
    }

    .filter-toggle-btn {
      background: none;
      border: none;
      color: var(--accent);
      cursor: pointer;
      font-size: 1.2rem;
      transition: transform 0.2s;
    }

    .filter-toggle-btn.collapsed {
      transform: rotate(-90deg);
    }

    .filter-section {
      display: grid;
      gap: 1rem;
      margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
    }

    .filter-row {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px, 1fr));
      gap: 1rem;
    }

    .filter-group {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 0.5rem;
    }

    .filter-group label {
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.05em;
    }

    .filter-pills {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 0.5rem;
    }

    .pill {
      padding: 0.4rem 0.85rem;
      background: rgba(74,158,255,0.1);
      border: 1px solid rgba(74,158,255,0.3);
      border-radius: 20px;
      color: var(--text-primary);
      cursor: pointer;
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      transition: all 0.2s;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .pill:hover {
      background: rgba(74,158,255,0.2);
      border-color: var(--accent);
    }

    .pill.active {
      background: var(--accent);
      color: #040d1f;
      border-color: var(--accent);
      font-weight: 600;
    }

    .filter-toggle {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.5rem;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .toggle-switch {
      width: 36px;
      height: 20px;
      background: rgba(74,158,255,0.2);
      border: 1px solid rgba(74,158,255,0.3);
      border-radius: 10px;
      position: relative;
      transition: background 0.2s;
    }

    .toggle-switch.active {
      background: var(--accent);
    }

    .toggle-switch::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      width: 16px;
      height: 16px;
      background: white;
      border-radius: 50%;
      top: 2px;
      left: 2px;
      transition: left 0.2s;
    }

    .toggle-switch.active::after {
      left: 18px;
    }

    .search-box {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.5rem;
      background: rgba(10,22,50,0.5);
      border: 1px solid rgba(74,158,255,0.2);
      border-radius: 8px;
      padding: 0.6rem 0.8rem;
      width: 100%;
    }

    .search-box input {
      background: none;
      border: none;
      color: var(--text-primary);
      width: 100%;
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      outline: none;
    }

    .search-box input::placeholder {
      color: var(--text-muted);
    }

    .filter-actions {
      display: flex;
      gap: 1rem;
      justify-content: flex-end;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border-color);
      padding-top: 1rem;
      margin-top: 1rem;
    }

    .btn {
      padding: 0.6rem 1.2rem;
      border-radius: 8px;
      border: none;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.2s;
    }

    .btn-primary {
      background: var(--accent);
      color: #040d1f;
    }

    .btn-primary:hover {
      opacity: 0.9;
      transform: translateY(-1px);
    }

    .btn-secondary {
      background: rgba(74,158,255,0.1);
      color: var(--accent);
      border: 1px solid rgba(74,158,255,0.3);
    }

    .btn-secondary:hover {
      background: rgba(74,158,255,0.2);
    }

    /* Results Toolbar */
    .results-toolbar {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      padding: 0.75rem 1rem;
      margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
      border-radius: 10px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 0.5rem;
    }

    .results-toolbar-left {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 1rem;
    }

    .results-count {
      font-family: 'Rajdhani', sans-serif;
      font-size: 1rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--text-primary);
    }

    .results-method-hint {
      font-size: 0.78rem;
      color: var(--text-muted);
    }

    .results-toolbar-right {
      display: flex;
      gap: 0.5rem;
    }

    .btn-sm {
      padding: 0.35rem 0.75rem;
      font-size: 0.78rem;
    }

    /* Primary action button for Select Required */
    .btn-action {
      background: rgba(34,197,94,0.15);
      color: #4ade80;
      border: 1px solid rgba(34,197,94,0.4);
      font-weight: 600;
      position: relative;
    }
    .btn-action:hover {
      background: rgba(34,197,94,0.25);
      border-color: rgba(34,197,94,0.6);
    }
    .btn-action svg {
      width: 14px;
      height: 14px;
      margin-right: 0.3rem;
      vertical-align: -2px;
    }
    /* Subtle pulse when nothing selected */
    @keyframes gentle-pulse {
      0%, 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(34,197,94,0.3); }
      50% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(34,197,94,0); }
    }
    .btn-action.pulse {
      animation: gentle-pulse 2.5s ease-in-out infinite;
    }
    /* Getting started hint */
    .getting-started-hint {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.5rem;
      padding: 0.6rem 1rem;
      margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
      background: rgba(34,197,94,0.06);
      border: 1px solid rgba(34,197,94,0.15);
      border-radius: 8px;
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      color: var(--text-muted);
    }
    .getting-started-hint svg {
      width: 16px;
      height: 16px;
      color: #4ade80;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .getting-started-hint strong { color: #4ade80; }
    .getting-started-hint .dismiss-hint {
      margin-left: auto;
      background: none;
      border: none;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      cursor: pointer;
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      padding: 0 0.3rem;
      opacity: 0.5;
    }
    .getting-started-hint .dismiss-hint:hover { opacity: 1; }

    .results-section-header {
      padding: 0.5rem 0.8rem;
      font-family: 'Rajdhani', sans-serif;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--accent);
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.05em;
    }

    .results-section-header.optional {
      color: var(--text-muted);
      margin-top: 0.5rem;
    }

    /* Results Section */
    .results-container {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 0.35rem;
    }

    .result-row {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
      border-radius: 8px;
      padding: 0.6rem 0.8rem;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.2s;
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: 0.6rem;
    }

    .result-row:hover {
      background: rgba(10,22,50,0.95);
      border-color: rgba(74,158,255,0.25);
    }

    .result-row.expanded {
      background: rgba(10,22,50,0.95);
    }

    .result-checkbox {
      width: 20px;
      height: 20px;
      margin-top: 2px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      cursor: pointer;
      accent-color: var(--accent);
    }

    .result-main {
      flex: 1;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 0.2rem;
    }

    .result-header {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 0.5rem;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .result-citation {
      font-family: 'Courier New', monospace;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--accent);
      font-size: 0.85rem;
    }

    .result-title {
      color: var(--text-primary);
      font-weight: 500;
      font-size: 0.9rem;
    }

    .result-badges {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 0.4rem;
    }

    .badge {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      padding: 0.15rem 0.45rem;
      background: rgba(74,158,255,0.15);
      border-radius: 3px;
      font-size: 0.65rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
      color: var(--accent);
    }

    .badge-provision {
      background: rgba(251,146,60,0.2);
      color: #fb923c;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 0.03em;
    }
    .badge-clause {
      background: rgba(59,130,246,0.2);
      color: #93c5fd;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 0.03em;
    }

    .badge-rfo {
      background: rgba(34,197,94,0.15);
      color: #86efac;
    }

    .badge-reg {
      background: rgba(59,130,246,0.15);
      color: #93c5fd;
    }

    .badge-reg-far {
      background: rgba(59,130,246,0.15);
      color: #93c5fd;
    }

    .badge-reg-dfars {
      background: rgba(168,85,247,0.15);
      color: #c4b5fd;
    }

    .badge-reg-dear {
      background: rgba(236,72,153,0.15);
      color: #f9a8d4;
    }

    .badge-reg-vaar {
      background: rgba(20,184,166,0.15);
      color: #5eead4;
    }

    .badge-reg-other {
      background: rgba(251,191,36,0.15);
      color: #fde68a;
    }

    .result-meta {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 1rem;
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      color: var(--text-muted);
    }

    .applicability-dots {
      display: flex;
      gap: 0.3rem;
      align-items: center;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .dot {
      width: 8px;
      height: 8px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      display: inline-block;
    }

    .dot.required {
      background: #22c55e;
    }

    .dot.applicable {
      background: var(--accent);
    }

    .dot.optional {
      background: #64748b;
    }

    .result-detail {
      display: none;
      margin-top: 1rem;
      padding-top: 1rem;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border-color);
    }

    .result-row.expanded .result-detail {
      display: block;
    }

    .detail-section {
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
    }

    .detail-label {
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.05em;
      margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
    }

    .detail-text {
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      line-height: 1.6;
      color: var(--text-primary);
      white-space: pre-wrap;
      word-break: break-word;
    }

    /* ======= Floating Selection Panel (right side) ======= */
    .sel-panel {
      position: fixed;
      right: 1rem;
      top: 50%;
      transform: translateY(-50%);
      z-index: 200;
      display: none;
      flex-direction: column;
      width: 52px;
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
      border-radius: 14px;
      box-shadow: 0 4px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
      transition: width 0.25s ease;
      overflow: hidden;
      max-height: 80vh;
    }
    .sel-panel.visible { display: flex; }
    .sel-panel.expanded { width: 300px; }

    .sel-compact {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      padding: 0.6rem 0;
      gap: 0.6rem;
      cursor: pointer;
    }
    .sel-panel.expanded .sel-compact { display: none; }

    .sel-count-badge {
      background: var(--accent);
      color: #040d1f;
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      width: 32px; height: 32px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    }
    .sel-compact-icon {
      font-size: 1rem;
      color: var(--accent);
      writing-mode: vertical-rl;
      font-weight: 700;
      font-family: 'Rajdhani', sans-serif;
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .sel-expanded {
      display: none;
      flex-direction: column;
      height: 100%;
      min-height: 0;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .sel-panel.expanded .sel-expanded { display: flex; }

    .sel-exp-header {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding: 0.8rem 1rem;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .sel-exp-header h4 {
      font-family: 'Rajdhani', sans-serif;
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--text-primary);
    }
    .sel-collapse-btn {
      background: none; border: none; color: var(--text-muted);
      cursor: pointer; font-size: 1.1rem; padding: 0.2rem;
    }

    .sel-list {
      flex: 1;
      overflow-y: auto;
      padding: 0.5rem;
      min-height: 0;
    }
    .sel-list-item {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.5rem;
      padding: 0.35rem 0.5rem;
      border-radius: 6px;
      font-size: 0.78rem;
      color: var(--text-primary);
      transition: background 0.15s;
    }
    .sel-list-item:hover { background: rgba(74,158,255,0.08); }
    .sel-list-id {
      font-family: 'Courier New', monospace;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--accent);
      font-size: 0.72rem;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      min-width: 80px;
    }
    .sel-list-title {
      flex: 1;
      white-space: nowrap;
      overflow: hidden;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
      color: var(--text-muted);
    }
    .sel-list-x {
      background: none; border: none; color: #ef4444;
      cursor: pointer; font-size: 0.85rem; padding: 0 0.2rem;
      flex-shrink: 0; opacity: 0.6;
    }
    .sel-list-x:hover { opacity: 1; }

    .sel-exp-actions {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 0.4rem;
      padding: 0.6rem 0.8rem;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border-color);
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .sel-exp-actions .btn { font-size: 0.8rem; padding: 0.5rem; text-align: center; }

    /* ======= Preview / Edit Page (replaces modal) ======= */
    .preview-overlay {
      display: none;
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      background: var(--bg-dark);
      z-index: 500;
      overflow-y: auto;
    }
    .preview-overlay.visible { display: block; }

    .preview-wrap {
      max-width: 1100px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 5rem 1.5rem 4rem;
    }

    .preview-topbar {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      margin-bottom: 2rem;
      gap: 1rem;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }
    .preview-topbar h2 {
      font-family: 'Rajdhani', sans-serif;
      font-size: 1.6rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--text-primary);
    }
    .preview-topbar-actions { display: flex; gap: 0.6rem; }

    .preview-section {
      margin-bottom: 2.5rem;
    }
    .preview-section-title {
      font-family: 'Rajdhani', sans-serif;
      font-size: 1.15rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--accent);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
      padding-bottom: 0.5rem;
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
    }

    /* IBR table */
    .ibr-table {
      width: 100%;
      border-collapse: collapse;
      table-layout: fixed;
    }
    .ibr-table th, .ibr-table td {
      vertical-align: top;
    }
    .ibr-table th {
      text-align: left;
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.05em;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
    }
    .ibr-table th:nth-child(1),
    .ibr-table td:nth-child(1) { width: 120px; }
    .ibr-table th:nth-child(2),
    .ibr-table td:nth-child(2) { width: 35%; }
    .ibr-table th:nth-child(4),
    .ibr-table td:nth-child(4) { width: 28px; }
    .ibr-table td {
      padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(74,158,255,0.06);
      color: var(--text-primary);
      word-wrap: break-word;
      overflow-wrap: break-word;
    }
    .ibr-table td:first-child {
      font-family: 'Courier New', monospace;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--accent);
      white-space: nowrap;
      overflow: hidden;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
    }
    .ibr-table tr:hover td { background: rgba(74,158,255,0.04); }
    .ibr-remove {
      background: none; border: none; color: #ef4444;
      cursor: pointer; font-size: 0.8rem; opacity: 0.5;
    }
    .ibr-remove:hover { opacity: 1; }

    /* Full text clause card */
    .ft-card {
      background: rgba(10,22,50,0.5);
      border: 1px solid rgba(74,158,255,0.1);
      border-radius: 10px;
      padding: 1.2rem;
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
    }
    .ft-card-header {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
    }
    .ft-card-id {
      font-family: 'Courier New', monospace;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--accent);
      font-size: 0.9rem;
    }
    .ft-card-title {
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--text-primary);
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      margin-left: 0.6rem;
    }
    .ft-card textarea {
      width: 100%;
      min-height: 200px;
      background: rgba(4,13,31,0.6);
      border: 1px solid rgba(74,158,255,0.15);
      border-radius: 8px;
      color: var(--text-primary);
      font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
      font-size: 0.82rem;
      line-height: 1.65;
      padding: 1rem;
      resize: vertical;
    }
    .ft-card textarea:focus {
      outline: none;
      border-color: var(--accent);
    }
    .ft-remove {
      background: none; border: none; color: #ef4444;
      cursor: pointer; font-size: 0.85rem; opacity: 0.5;
    }
    .ft-remove:hover { opacity: 1; }
    .fill-to-ibr, .ibr-to-fill, .ft-to-ibr, .ibr-to-ft {
      background: rgba(74,158,255,0.1);
      border: 1px solid rgba(74,158,255,0.35);
      color: #8ab8ff;
      cursor: pointer;
      font-size: 0.72rem;
      padding: 0.2rem 0.55rem;
      border-radius: 4px;
      margin-right: 0.35rem;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .fill-to-ibr:hover, .ibr-to-fill:hover, .ft-to-ibr:hover, .ibr-to-ft:hover {
      background: rgba(74,158,255,0.2);
      color: #c7ddff;
    }

    /* Prescription cell in tables */
    .prescription-cell {
      font-size: 0.78rem;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      max-width: 450px;
      line-height: 1.5;
      word-wrap: break-word;
    }

    /* Fill-in card IBR/FT tags */
    .fill-ibr-tag, .fill-ft-tag {
      display: inline-block;
      font-size: 0.6rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.05em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      padding: 0.2rem 0.5rem;
      border-radius: 4px;
      margin-right: 0.5rem;
      vertical-align: middle;
    }
    .fill-ibr-tag {
      background: rgba(59,130,246,0.18);
      color: #93c5fd;
    }
    .fill-ft-tag {
      background: rgba(168,85,247,0.18);
      color: #c4b5fd;
    }

    /* Fill-in card overrides */
    .fill-card {
      background: rgba(10,22,50,0.4);
      border: 1px solid rgba(74,158,255,0.12);
      border-radius: 12px;
      padding: 0;
      margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .fill-card-top {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding: 0.9rem 1.2rem;
      background: rgba(74,158,255,0.04);
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(74,158,255,0.08);
    }
    .fill-card-top-left {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.5rem;
    }
    .fill-card-id {
      font-family: 'Courier New', monospace;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--accent);
      font-size: 0.88rem;
    }
    .fill-card-title {
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--text-primary);
      font-size: 0.88rem;
    }
    .fill-card-body {
      padding: 1rem 1.2rem 1.2rem;
    }

    /* Fill-in prescription hint */
    .fill-prescription {
      font-size: 0.78rem;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      background: rgba(74,158,255,0.04);
      border-left: 3px solid rgba(74,158,255,0.3);
      padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem;
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
      border-radius: 0 6px 6px 0;
      line-height: 1.5;
    }

    /* Fill-in label */
    .fill-label {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.4rem;
      font-size: 0.72rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
      color: #f59e0b;
      margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    }
    .fill-label svg {
      width: 14px;
      height: 14px;
    }

    /* Fill-in textarea */
    .fill-card textarea {
      width: 100%;
      min-height: 160px;
      background: rgba(4,13,31,0.5);
      border: 1px solid rgba(245,158,11,0.2);
      border-radius: 8px;
      color: var(--text-primary);
      font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
      font-size: 0.82rem;
      line-height: 1.65;
      padding: 1rem;
      resize: vertical;
      transition: border-color 0.2s;
    }
    .fill-card textarea:focus {
      outline: none;
      border-color: #f59e0b;
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(245,158,11,0.1);
    }

    /* Fill-in highlighted text display */
    .fill-text-display {
      font-size: 0.82rem;
      line-height: 1.65;
      color: var(--text-primary);
      padding: 1rem;
      background: rgba(4,13,31,0.35);
      border: 1px solid rgba(74,158,255,0.08);
      border-radius: 8px;
      max-height: 300px;

@keyframes cfm-sb-spin { from { transform: rotate(0deg); } to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
@keyframes cfm-sb-orbit-a {
  0%   { transform: translate(0, 0); }
  25%  { transform: translate(14px, 8px); }
  50%  { transform: translate(32px, 26px); }
  75%  { transform: translate(10px, 46px); }
  100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
}
@keyframes cfm-sb-orbit-b {

  25%  { transform: translate(-12px, -8px); }
  50%  { transform: translate(-28px, -22px); }
  75%  { transform: translate(-8px, -42px); }
  100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
}

(b) Prohibition. 31 U.S.C. 1352 prohibits a recipient of a Federal contract, grant, loan, or cooperative agreement from using appropriated funds to pay any person for influencing or attempting to influence an officer or employee of any agency, a Member of Congress, an officer or employee of Congress, or an employee of a Member of Congress in connection with any covered Federal actions. In accordance with 31 U.S.C. 1352 the Contractor shall not use appropriated funds to pay any person for influencing or attempting to influence an officer or employee of any agency, a Member of Congress, an officer or employee of Congress, or an employee of a Member of Congress in connection with the award of this contractor the extension, continuation, renewal, amendment, or modification of this contract.
(1) The term appropriated funds does not include profit or fee from a covered Federal action.
(2) To the extent the Contractor can demonstrate that the Contractor has sufficient monies, other than Federal appropriated funds, the Government will assume that these other monies were spent for any influencing activities that would be unallowable if paid for with Federal appropriated funds.
(c) Exceptions. The prohibition in paragraph (b) of this clause does not apply under the following conditions:

(1) Agency and legislative liaison by Contractor employees.
(i) Payment of reasonable compensation made to an officer or employee of the Contractor if the payment is for agency and legislative liaison activities not directly related to this contract. For purposes of this paragraph, providing any information specifically requested by an agency or Congress is permitted at any time.
(ii) Participating with an agency in discussions that are not related to a specific solicitation for any covered Federal action, but that concern-
(A) The qualities and characteristics (including individual demonstrations) of the person’s products or services, conditions or terms of sale, and service capabilities; or
(B) The application or adaptation of the person’s products or services for an agency’s use.
(iii) Providing prior to formal solicitation of any covered Federal action any information not specifically requested but necessary for an agency to make an informed decision about initiation of a covered Federal action;
(iv) Participating in technical discussions regarding the preparation of an unsolicited proposal prior to its official submission; and
(v) Making capability presentations prior to formal solicitation of any covered Federal action by persons seeking awards from an agency pursuant to the provisions of the Small Business Act, as amended by Pub. L. 95-507, and subsequent amendments.

(2) Professional and technical services.
(i) A payment of reasonable compensation made to an officer or employee of a person requesting or receiving a covered Federal action or an extension, continuation, renewal, amendment, or modification of a covered Federal action, if payment is for professional or technical services rendered directly in the preparation, submission, or negotiation of any bid, proposal, or application for that Federal action or for meeting requirements imposed by or pursuant to law as a condition for receiving that Federal action.
(ii) Any reasonable payment to a person, other than an officer or employee of a person requesting or receiving a covered Federal action or an extension, continuation, renewal, amendment, or modification of a covered Federal action if the payment is for professional or technical services rendered directly in the preparation, submission, or negotiation of any bid, proposal, or application for that Federal action or for meeting requirements imposed by or pursuant to law as a condition for receiving that Federal action. Persons other than officers or employees of a person requesting or receiving a covered Federal action include consultants and trade associations.
(iii) As used in paragraph (c)(2) of this clause, "professional and technical services" are limited to advice and analysis directly applying any professional or technical discipline (for examples, see FAR 3.803(a)(2)(iii)).
(iv) Requirements imposed by or pursuant to law as a condition for receiving a covered Federal award include those required by law or regulation and any other requirements in the actual award documents.
(3) Only those communications and services expressly authorized by paragraphs (c)(1) and (2) of this clause are permitted.

(d) Disclosure.
(1) If the Contractor did not submit OMB Standard Form LLL, Disclosure of Lobbying Activities, with its offer, but registrants under the Lobbying Disclosure Act of 1995 have subsequently made a lobbying contact on behalf of the Contractor with respect to this contract, the Contractor shall complete and submit OMB Standard Form LLL to provide the name of the lobbying registrants, including the individuals performing the services.
(2) If the Contractor did submit OMB Standard Form LLL disclosure pursuant to paragraph (d) of the provision at FAR 52.203-11, Certification and Disclosure Regarding Payments to Influence Certain Federal Transactions, and a change occurs that affects Block 10 of the OMB Standard Form LLL (name and address of lobbying registrant or individuals performing services), the Contractor shall, at the end of the calendar quarter in which the change occurs, submit to the Contracting Officer within 30 days an updated disclosure using OMB Standard Form LLL.

(e) Penalties.
(1) Any person who makes an expenditure prohibited under paragraph (b) of this clause or who fails to file or amend the disclosure to be filed or amended by paragraph (d) of this clause shall be subject to civil penalties as provided for by 31 U.S.C. 1352. An imposition of a civil penalty does not prevent the Government from seeking any other remedy that may be applicable.
(2) Contractors may rely without liability on the representation made by their subcontractors in the certification and disclosure form.
(f) Cost allowability. Nothing in this clause makes allowable or reasonable any costs which would otherwise be unallowable or unreasonable. Conversely, costs made specifically unallowable by the requirements in this clause will not be made allowable under any other provision.

(g) Subcontracts.
(1) The Contractor shall obtain a declaration, including the certification and disclosure in paragraphs (c) and (d) of the provision at 52.203-11, Certification and Disclosure Regarding Payments to Influence Certain Federal Transactions, from each person requesting or receiving a subcontract under this contract that exceeds the threshold specified in FAR 3.808 on the date of subcontract award. The Contractor or subcontractor that awards the subcontract shall retain the declaration.
(2) A copy of each subcontractor disclosure form (but not certifications) shall be forwarded from tier to tier until received by the prime Contractor. Each subcontractor certification shall be retained in the subcontract file of the awarding Contractor.
(3) The Contractor shall include the substance of this clause, including this paragraph (g), in any subcontract that exceeds the threshold specified in FAR 3.808 on the date of subcontract award.

                <div class="detail-label">Full Prescription</div>
                <div class="detail-text">Insert the clause at FAR 52.203-13, Contractor Code of Business Ethics and Conduct, in solicitations and contracts if the value of the contract is expected to exceed $7.5 million and the performance period is 120 days or more.</div>
